title: Malachi Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Malachi 3: the messenger who prepares the way, the refiner's fire, the tithe in the storehouse, and the book of memory.

questions.text: What will the messenger whom Yahweh sends do?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:1 says: Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me.

answers.text: Carry the law to the nations

questions.text: What two things is the coming one compared to?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:2 asks who can endure the day of his coming, for he is like a refiner's fire and like launderers' soap.

answers.text: A storm at sea and a flood
A refiner's fire and launderers' soap
A roaring lion and an eagle
A sharp sword and a shield

questions.text: Whom will he purify, sitting as a refiner and purifier of silver?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:3 says he will purify the sons of Levi and refine them as gold and silver, so that they offer to Yahweh in righteousness.

questions.text: Against whom does Yahweh say he will be a swift witness?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:5 says he will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, the adulterers, the perjurers, those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow and the fatherless, and those who deprive the foreigner of justice.

answers.text: Against the kings who make war

questions.text: What reason does Yahweh give that the sons of Jacob are not consumed?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:6 says: For I, Yahweh, don't change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

answers.text: That he, Yahweh, does not change
That they have kept his ordinances
That the priests pray for them

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies call the people to do, promising to do the same for them?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:7 says: Return to me, and I will return to you, says Yahweh of Armies.

questions.text: In what were the people robbing God?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:8 asks whether a man will rob God, and answers that they rob him in tithes and offerings.

answers.text: In the firstborn of their flocks

questions.text: What does Yahweh promise if they bring the whole tithe into the storehouse?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:10 says that if they do, he will open them the windows of heaven and pour out a blessing for which there will not be room enough.

answers.text: That their enemies will flee before them
That their sons will serve in the temple
That the priests will bless them
That he will open the windows of heaven and pour out a blessing

questions.text: What was written before Yahweh for those who feared him?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:16 says that Yahweh listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared Yahweh and honored his name.

questions.text: How does Yahweh say he will spare those who are his own possession?
questions.explanation: Malachi 3:17 says he will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.

answers.text: As a king spares a city that surrenders
As a shepherd spares a lamb
As a man spares his own son who serves him
As a judge spares an innocent man
